title: A Treasure Carried Home
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A good man, Ezra, loved the Lord
With all his heart, each day.
He read the scriptures carefully
And learned to live God's way.

[Chorus]
God's words are like a treasure bright
To carry in your heart.
They make you wise, they make you strong,
Right from the very start.

[Verse 2]
The king said, "Ezra, go and teach
The people far from here."
So Ezra carried God's own words
Like treasure, held so dear.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, a story's told
Of God, before you sleep.
His words are tucked inside your heart,
A treasure you can keep.

[Chorus]
mood: Treasure music. A slow, careful rocking pulse moves under the voice, unhurried and thoughtful, like Ezra turning the pages he loved and carrying them gently down a long road. The chorus glows a little warmer, as if a treasure box has opened. By the last verse the pulse eases even slower and sinks lower, tucking the words away for the night.
